item.title: The Trillion-Dollar AI Software Development Stack: A Summary
item.description:
Based on The Trillion Dollar AI Software Development Stack by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z).

Introduction

We are entering a new era of software development powered by AI-assisted tools and agents.
Andreessen Horowitz’s article argues that this shift could unlock a trillion-dollar opportunity in developer productivity and tooling.

Historically, developer tools were not the biggest software market. But generative AI is changing that, for two reasons:

  1. Developers often build the tools they themselves need.
  2. The addressable market is massive — over 30 million developers globally, each creating an estimated $100,000 of annual value.

If AI improves productivity by even a modest margin, the compounding effect could reshape the entire software industry.

item.title: Ebpf
item.description:
eBPF: The Revolutionary Linux Kernel Technology

What is eBPF?

eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) is a revolutionary technology that allows you to run sandboxed programs in the Linux kernel without changing kernel source code or loading kernel modules. It provides a safe and efficient way to extend kernel functionality for networking, security, tracing, and performance monitoring.

Think of eBPF as a virtual machine inside the Linux kernel that can execute custom programs with near-native performance while maintaining system safety and stability.

item.title: Time Boxing
item.description: A lot of times I find it difficult just start. Getting to work would mean winning some battle to decide what to do and what not to do. That is not everything. It involves me to convince myself why do something and not some other thing. That is the real deal and that is where all the pain is. The mental pain involved in fighting our own motivations is huge and unimaginable. The only way to escape it seems is to just log off and come back to work some other time. Does this sound familiar to you? It happens all the time to me.

item.title: Staying Creative
item.description:
We are naturally creative and I would go so far as to say our happiness is driven by our creativity. It doesn’t end there. Creativity is what keeps up in the day working. It keeps some people up in the night as well. Its is creativity that drives us all the way.

Even small creative acts lead to more creative acts and everything else follows. Creativity sparks creativity. You can find creative tasks in almost everything. You just need to start with something that will improve you. The opposite of creativity is dullness and there are some actions that only begets dullness. Some example are idling, consuming shit targeted at you online and engaging in negative self depreciating activities. All of these can land you in dullness.

item.title: AI Normalization
item.description: I was like everyone in the tech, a bit unsettled at what is in store with the new AI around. There is a crazy rush and a sense of anxiety due to all the noise that is out there. Years ago I decided to not take social media seriously. It is still the same but now I don’t take anyone who talks of AI seriously. There is no need to. If AI is going to the status quo of how we carry out our businesses then it is not going to be hard nor is it going to be a differentiator. You and I don’t need to join the mad rush. It will come to you what ever the great power it is, it is going come to you and lay at your door step. That is the basic law of economics. Supply will automatically find its demand, especially if it is in abundance. It doesn’t take a second thought to understand that AI tech is in abundant supply. That is because it is easy. So worry not.

item.title: On Writing
item.description: Writing a blog is a habit and like any habit it is going to take time to attain it. Honestly, I do not possess it. I would like to work on it going forward.
